rules.text: IF the first retriever's confidence is in its lowest 10% THEN escalate retrieval (locked)
IF the first retriever is unsure (lowest 20%) THEN escalate, skipping one size, and ensemble
IF after escalating the shortlists disagree AND the bigger retriever is also unsure THEN escalate again and ensemble
IF the answer is empty or says it cannot be determined THEN escalate (locked)
IF the answer is yes/no THEN keep it
IF some of the answer's words are not in the passages THEN escalate; agree -> accept, else vote
IF the answerer's token confidence is in its lowest 15% THEN escalate
